name: atrium
description: Atrium cockpit as a Claude Code pane: your Linear sprint, the ticket you're on, wave PRDs and mockup links — read through the Linear MCP connector, with the project conventions briefed to the model automatically.

linearServer.title: Linear MCP server
linearServer.description: Name of the Linear MCP server as it appears in tool names (mcp__<server>__list_issues). Auto-detected when a server name contains 'linear'.

project.title: Linear project
project.description: Pin a Linear project name. Empty = auto-detect from the repo folder name (or the project you picked in the pane).

wavePrefix.title: Sprint label prefix
wavePrefix.description: Sprint-label prefix(es), comma-separated. When no label matches, sprint-ish labels (Wave 3, Sprint 12, Phase 2) are detected automatically.

pollSeconds.title: Auto-refresh (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: Rolling auto-refresh of the board, in seconds. 0 = refresh only on /atrium refresh, after Linear writes, and when a turn ends with a stale board.

openOnStart.title: Open pane on start
openOnStart.description: Open the Atrium pane when the session starts (it waits until the terminal is wide enough to dock it).

briefModel.title: Brief the model
briefModel.description: Add the project conventions and the current ticket to the system prompt so the model labels tickets, names branches and places planning files the way the board expects.
